text:
maya: Quick sync — post-launch bug vs enhancement decision. We shipped last week and have 8 customer-reported items. Two are high-severity (P0 crash on onboarding, P1 embeddings mismatch). Would prefer a short hotpatch sprint if ops timeline allows. Otherwise, fold lower-impact items into next feature wave. Quick context:

- P0: onboarding crash (happens ~2% of flows)
- P1: embeddings mismatch in custom pipeline
- P2: UI jitter on model selector
- P3: docs/ux wording

Suggest criteria: customer impact, rollback risk, release complexity.
Can folks weigh in with ETA and vote (hotpatch vs queue for wave)?

alex: On the crash — we can triage and likely patch in 2 dev-days, but deploy slot is Thurs. If we do hotpatch we should freeze non-critical deploys.

todd: UI jitter is design-low, I can bundle small CSS fix in next sprint. Not urgent.

nina: Ops: Thurs deploy window is open; risk if we do DB migration. If patch is a code change w/o schema, ops is fine.

will: CS — multiple paying customers hit onboarding crash. They want fix now. :frowning: 

ops-bot: Scheduled deploy windows: Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. Current load stable. :white_check_mark:

alex: Proposed split:
```
- Hotpatch sprint (3 days): P0 crash, embeddings mismatch
- Next wave: UI jitter, docs, backlog polish
```

maya: Sounds good. @todd @nina can we confirm no migration risk for P0? And @will can you scope customer comms?

todd: Confirmed — no backend changes, purely guard clause + client check.

nina: Verified — PR looks safe, no schema changes.

will: I'll draft a short message, offer workaround, ETA for fix after deploy window.

maya: OK plan: start hotpatch Friday morning, aim to merge by Thu deploy window, freeze non-critical work. If anything blocks, fallback is canary for affected customers.

alex: :thumbsup: I'll spin up a small branch and assign reviewers.

todd: :thumbsup:

nina: :thumbsup:

will: Will post to customers and add to support playbook.

maya: Thanks team. I'll update roadmap board and mark remaining items for next wave. Closing thread unless objections.

alex: No objections.

maya: Thanks — moving to action items.
